h1: Pricing your property before you sell in Pondicherry
lead: Owners lose money in two ways: quoting low because a broker was in a hurry, or quoting far above the street and waiting a year for a buyer who never comes.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Buyers compare your property with alternatives nearby, not with what you paid or what you need. They look at road, approval, size, frontage, documents and what similar properties have actually sold for.

bullets: Recent registered sales near you, with dates
Current asking prices for comparable properties
The government’s guideline value, as a floor to understand, not a price
Specific features: road width, approach, corner position, approval

paras: A realistic asking price brings enquiries in the first weeks, when interest is highest. An optimistic one stalls, and a property that has been listed for months starts to look suspect. Leave room to negotiate, but not much.

Our [free valuation](/free-property-valuation) uses recent registrations and local deals, and gives a written range with the reasoning. The decision on the asking price remains yours. See [how we sell](/sell-property-pondicherry).

blocks.p: A free valuation costs nothing and takes one visit.
